title: 第76章 让老太太去求求唐敬啊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐敬，刘温等大臣为了帮炎文帝分忧，在状元楼吵得如火如荼。而这时，林豹也将柳公瑾的信，送到了柳家。“在下锦衣卫百户林豹，奉命给柳家送来柳公瑾柳大人的亲笔信，还请通报下。”林豹跳下马，冲着门房拱了拱手。然而门房还没说话，大门内已经走出来了一个女人，皱着眉头道：“柳公瑾的信？从锦衣卫写出来的？”柳公瑾的案子锦衣卫接手了，并不是什么秘密。“正是。”这几日查柳公瑾，顺带查了一下柳家人，林豹知道眼前的女人，是柳公瑾的弟弟柳公知的妻子姜氏。姜氏是御史姜浩然的妹妹，算唐逸的二舅妈，林豹也没有隐瞒，道：“信是柳公瑾柳大人亲笔所写，是唐逸让在下马不停蹄送回柳家报平安的……”话没说完，姜氏便有些烦躁道：“信给我，你可以走了。”林豹皱了皱眉，唐逸说了，信件要亲手交给柳老太太，免得老人家担心。“信给我转交，你可以走了，没听到？”姜氏冷着脸重复了一遍。林豹下意识想要拔刀砍人，但想到是唐逸的舅妈，忍住了。“也罢，那就有劳了，信件务必送到老夫人的手上。”林豹将信件递给姜氏，转身跃上马背疾驰而去。姜氏看着林豹远去的背影，脸色渐渐变冷，她抬手将信件撕成了碎片，随手塞进身侧丫鬟的嘴里。“二夫人，这是大爷给老妇人的信件。”门房脸色微变，现在柳家全家都在为老爷的消息发愁呢，你怎么给撕了？“都给我听好了，今日这件事，你们都没有看到，也没有听到。”“谁敢透露半个字，杖杀！”姜氏冷冷扫了众人一眼，道：“想想你们的家人，柳公瑾从锦衣卫写来信件，肯定是要柳家将所有财产卖了，来填补亏空的。”“那可是几十万两，就算将整个柳家卖了，也不够填补亏空。”“到时候，连你们包括你们的家人也会被发卖。”家丁门房听到这话，都面色煞白低下了头。姜氏冷哼一声，转身回了府。丝毫没有注意她的丫鬟，将满嘴的信件碎片抠出来，藏进了嘴中。今日柳家人都在大厅聚集议事，姜氏进了大厅，便直接走到二房那边坐了下来。这时的柳家一片死寂，没有半点生机。姜氏撇了撇嘴，要不是想要分家得到更多的财产，柳家这破事她是半点不想参与。就在这时，柳家老太太拄着拐杖走了出来。这几日柳家大乱，是已经几年没有管过事的柳老太太再度出山，坐镇柳家，才让柳家暂时稳定下来。“娘，我们已经动用了所有所能动用的关系，还是打听不到大哥的一点消息。”柳家老二柳公知面容憔悴，这几日为了大哥柳公瑾的事，他四处奔波，却一无所获，早已经疲惫不堪。“娘都知道，这不是你的错。”柳老太太摇了摇头，老脸上嘴角苦涩：“你爹走了之后，也是人走茶凉，以前的关系便不是那么牢靠了。”“再加上这个案子，发生得不是时候。”“陛下要对北狄用兵，要开战，是最需要钱的时候。”“这时候你大哥被诬陷渎职，挪用税银，会被陛下杀鸡儆猴的。”“轻则全家流放，重则全族人头落地，这时候只要有点利益心的人，自然都是离咱们越远越好。”柳老太太没有怨天尤人，只是觉得有点伤感，当年柳老爷子还是吏部尚书的时候，柳家门庭若市，门槛都快被人踏平了。如今，柳家落魄，别说以前那些关系，现在是狗都嫌。听完老太太的话，柳家几十口都齐齐垂下脑袋，面色沮丧。“娘，现在不仅仅是相公的事了……”柳公瑾的妻子沈氏看向柳老太太，咬了咬唇道：“儿媳已经接到了好几个家族的消息，他们……他们不想被咱们柳家连累，都想休妻。”“恐怕等相公的案子一定性，小姑子还有家里嫁出去的那几个女娃，都会被休妻送回柳家。”柳家众人闻言，都脸色难看。要是柳家女都被退婚，那柳家在京都将会成为大笑话，而且还会坐实唐逸的母亲柳如玉善妒的事实。现在那些家族之所以先告知柳家，而没有直接休妻，无非就是还要点脸罢了。但柳公瑾案子只要定性，真的是在贪污受贿挪用税银，那些人完全可以以家教不严为借口，将柳家女人都休了，到时候整个京都的人也不会说什么。“无论如何，也不能让这种事情发生，否则柳家，妹妹和爹的名声就全毁了。”柳公知攥紧拳头，咬牙切齿。柳老太太痛苦闭上眼睛，她又何尝不知道事情的严重性呢？若是平常，陛下或许会念及老爷子的功劳，顶多对柳公瑾施以惩戒。但现在情况特殊，陛下可能会拿柳公瑾杀鸡儆猴！“彦哥儿呢？怎么没见到他？”柳老太太并不知道柳文彦被抓进锦衣卫的事，柳家人怕老太太受不了，没有告诉她这件事。现在老太太问起，沈氏也只能找借口糊弄：“平远伯世子过来找他，说是有一个人能够帮他救相公出来，他跟着梁绍走了，现在还没回来。”老太太闻言叹了口气，现在连柳家二子亲自出面求人，都没有任何作用。梁绍那小子瞧着就不是靠谱的，他找的人能靠谱。“其实吧，也不是完全没有办法！”这时，一个女人的声音响起。所有人循声望去，说话的是柳公知的妻子姜氏。姜氏正在拨弄着指甲，见到柳家众人看向自己，便淡淡道：“之前没有办法，那是因为求人的是柳公知，所以才没有办法。”“但要是娘愿意出面求人，效果肯定会更好。”“公爹当年在位的时候，娘也帮过不少人，要是娘愿意求人，那些人多多少少会给一点面子。”闻言，柳家众人面色大变。柳老太太都已经六十岁了，因为丈夫和最宠爱的女儿相继离世，悲伤过度，以至于她六十岁却和七十岁的老人没什么区别。白发苍苍，身形佝偻，满脸皱纹，现在，却还要她出面求人？“你胡说八道什么？！”柳公知猛地站了起来，怒喝。姜氏被吼得一哆嗦，当即站了起来，一手叉腰冲着柳公知怒斥：“你和我凶什么凶？老娘还不是为了你柳家着想？”“你柳公知这几日到处求人，膝盖都快跪碎了，有人理你吗？”“但老太太不一样，老太太有诰命在身，那些人谁敢让他跪？”“还有唐敬，唐敬不是她女婿吗？”“去求求唐敬啊！说不定唐敬愿意帮忙的呢！”听到这话，柳家众人脸色都变了。当年柳如玉病故，柳老太太当众给了唐敬一巴掌，逼着唐敬不准改立嫡子，这事曾闹得满城风雨。现在唐画三元及第，在京都年轻一辈中名列前茅，唐敬和颜霜玉那个恶妇肯定恨透了老太太。老太太这时候找上门，不得受尽唐家欺辱？
content_en: Tang Jing, Liu Wen and other ministers had a fierce quarrel in Zhuangyuan Tower in order to help Emperor Yan Wen share his worries.At this time, Lin Bao also sent Liu Gongjin's letter to the Liu family."I, Lin Bao, a member of the Jinyi Guards, have been ordered to deliver an autographed letter from Mr. Liu Gongjin Liu to the Liu family. Please inform me." Lin Bao jumped off his horse and raised his hands to the concierge.However, before the concierge could speak, a woman had already walked out of the door, frowning and saying, "Liu Gongjin's letter? Was it written by Jin Yiwei?" It was not a secret that Jin Yiwei took over Liu Gongjin's case."Exactly." In the past few days, he checked Liu Gongjin and the Liu family. Lin Bao knew that the woman in front of him was Jiang, the wife of Liu Gongjin's brother Liu Gongzhi.Mrs. Jiang was the sister of the imperial censor Jiang Haoran, and was Tang Yi's second aunt. Lin Bao did not hide it, saying: "The letter was written by Mr. Liu Gongjin Liu, and it was Tang Yirang who dismounted and sent it back to the Liu family to report that he was safe..." Before he finished speaking, Mrs. Jiang became a little irritable and said: "Give me the letter, and you can go." Lin Bao frowned, Tang Yi said that the letter should be handed over to Mrs. Liu in person, so as not to worry the old lady."Give me the letter and you can leave, didn't you hear?" Ms. Jiang repeated with a cold face.Lin Bao subconsciously wanted to draw a knife and kill someone, but thought that it was Tang Yi's aunt, so he held back."Well, that's all. The letter must be delivered to the old lady." Lin Bao handed the letter to Mrs. Jiang, turned around, jumped on the horse and galloped away.Mrs. Jiang's face gradually turned cold as she watched Lin Bao's retreating back. She raised her hand to tear the letter into pieces and stuffed it into the mouth of the maid beside her."Second Madam, this is a letter from the master to the old woman." The concierge's face changed slightly. Now the whole Liu family is worried about the news about the master. Why did you tear it up?"Listen to me. You haven't seen or heard anything about today's incident." "Whoever dares to reveal a word will be killed with a stick!" Mrs. Jiang glanced at everyone coldly and said, "Think about your family. Liu Gongjin wrote a letter from Jin Yiwei, and it must be to ask the general of the Liu family toAll the property was sold to make up for the shortfall."That's several hundred thousand taels. Even if the entire Liu family is sold, it won't be enough to make up for the shortfall.""When the time comes, even you and your family will be sold."When the servant heard this, he turned pale and lowered his head.Mrs. Jiang snorted coldly, turned around and returned to her house.The maid, who didn't pay any attention to her, dug out the fragments of letters in her mouth and hid them in her mouth.Today, the Liu family members gathered in the hall to discuss matters. When Jiang entered the hall, she walked directly to the second room and sat down.At this time, the Liu family was completely silent, with no life at all.Ms. Jiang curled her lips. If she didn't want to split up the family and get more property, she wouldn't want to participate in the Liu family's mess at all.At this moment, the old lady of the Liu family walked out on crutches.The Liu family has been in chaos these days. Old Mrs. Liu, who had not been in charge for several years, came out again and took charge of the Liu family, which temporarily stabilized the Liu family."Mom, we have used all the connections at our disposal, but we still can't get any news about eldest brother." Liu Gongzhi, the second eldest son of the Liu family, looked haggard. In the past few days, he had been running around for the eldest brother Liu Gongjin's affairs, but found nothing. He was already exhausted."Mother knows that this is not your fault." Old Mrs. Liu shook her head, with a bitter look on her old face: "After your father left, he also left the tea, and the previous relationship was not so strong." "In addition, this case happened at the wrong time." "Your Majesty wants to use troops against Beidi and start a war, which is the time when money is most needed." "At this time, your eldest brother was falsely accused of blasphemy.If you misappropriate tax money, your Majesty will be killed as a warning to the monkeys. ""The whole family will be exiled, and the whole clan will be killed. At this time, anyone with a sense of profit will naturally stay as far away from us as possible." Old Mrs. Liu did not blame others, but she felt a little sad. When Mr. Liu was still the Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Liu family was like a bustling family, and the doorsteps were about to be stepped down.Nowadays, the Liu family is in dire straits. Let alone those relationships in the past, they are now considered a nuisance.After hearing what the old lady said, dozens of members of the Liu family all lowered their heads, looking depressed."Mom, it's not just our husband's business now..." Liu Gongjin's wife Shen looked at Old Mrs. Liu, bit her lip and said, "My daughter-in-law has received news from several families. They... they don't want to be implicated by our Liu family, and they all want to divorce their wives." "I'm afraid that when the case of our husband is finalized, my sister-in-law and the girls who were married off in the family will be divorced and sent back to the Liu family." Everyone in the Liu family looked ugly after hearing this.If all the daughters of the Liu family are divorced, the Liu family will become a big joke in Kyoto, and it will also be confirmed that Tang Yi's mother Liu Ruyu is jealous.Now, the reason why those families informed the Liu family first instead of divorcing their wives directly was just to show their respect.But as long as Liu Gongjin's case is clarified, it is really about embezzlement, bribery and misappropriation of tax money. Those people can use lax upbringing as an excuse to divorce all the women in the Liu family, and no one in Kyoto will say anything at that time."No matter what, we can't let this happen, otherwise the reputation of the Liu family, my sister and my father will be completely ruined." Liu Gongzhi clenched his fists and gritted his teeth.Old Mrs. Liu closed her eyes in pain. How could she not know the seriousness of the matter?If it were normal, His Majesty would probably think of the old man's merits and at most punish Liu Gongjin.But now that the situation is special, His Majesty may use Liu Gongjin to kill chickens and scare monkeys!"Where's Brother Yan? Why haven't you seen him?" Old Mrs. Liu didn't know that Liu Wenyan was taken into Jinyiwei. The Liu family was afraid that the old lady wouldn't be able to bear it, so they didn't tell her about it.Now that the old lady asked, Shen could only find an excuse to fool him: "Prince Pingyuan came to him and said that there was a person who could help him rescue his husband. He followed Liang Shao and has not come back yet." The old lady sighed after hearing this. Now even the second son of the Liu family personally came forward to ask for help, but it had no effect.That guy Liang Shao didn't seem to be reliable, so the person he was looking for was."Actually, it's not completely impossible!" At this time, a woman's voice sounded.Everyone looked up and saw that the person speaking was Liu Gongzhi's wife, Mrs. Jiang.Mrs. Jiang was fiddling with her nails. When she saw everyone in the Liu family looking at her, she said calmly: "There was nothing we could do before. That was because it was Mr. Liu who asked for help, so there was nothing we could do." "But if mother is willing to come forward to ask for help, the effect will definitely be better." "When father-in-law was in power, mother also helped a lot of people. If mother is willing to ask for help, those people will give more or less face." Hearing this, everyone in the Liu family changed their faces.willow
title_en: Chapter 76 Let the old lady go and beg Tang Jing!
